children: The Czech government will restart the regulation of fuel prices and cut the diesel tax for the month of October, as conflict in the Middle East pressures markets, the Finance Ministry said on Monday.

In another measure, the ministry said the government approved a proposal for an extraordinary tax on the refining sector, which would be applied in 2026 and 2027 and be set at 50% of the increase in gross margins versus 2025.
